name: quadtree
description: A 2D spatial partitioning structure used to index points and perform fast regional range queries.
aiPromptContext: Use this block to partition a 2D space recursively and query subsets of points falling inside rectangular boundary dimensions.

parameters.name: boundary
parameters.description: Rectangle configuration mapping standard { x, y, w, h } properties.

parameters.name: capacity
parameters.description: Maximum points allowable per node before splitting.
